name: AuthorBio
description: Author biography card: avatar, name, role, and markdown bio. Fully input-driven — pass the details directly, or pass slug to resolve them from the site's author registry (direct props override registry fields).

a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-06 — beta→stable: AT snapshots bootstrapped across base/light/dark/forced-colors (all beta-matrix stories green, deterministic); axe color-contrast passed in light+dark+forced for the bordered color surface; stale compliance story removed. Tagline renders as plain Text; the author-data `[@](url)` was a content error (the `@` is a handle mention, not a link) corrected in content/authors to `@digitaltableteur`, so no markdown link renders in the byline.

slug.description:
Optional author slug resolved from the site's authors registry; direct
props below override the registry fields.

name.description: Author name. Required unless `slug` resolves it.

imageUrl.description: Avatar image source: a URL, an imported asset path, or static image data.

role.description: Role/title shown under the name (e.g. "Founder, CEO").

bio.description:
Biography text; markdown after the first paragraph. The first paragraph
renders as the lead/tagline.

email.description: Contact email rendered as a mailto link when `showContact` is set.

className.description: Optional CSS class for styling extension

heading.description: Optional custom heading text (defaults to the author name)

showContact.description: Render the author's contact email (mailto) after the bio, if the author has one.

forbiddenUse: Bypass design tokens or skip forced-colors verification at beta.
dense: About-the-author block: Avatar + name + biography paragraph; end-of-article slot

usage.description: About-the-author block with avatar, name, and short biography — the end-of-article companion to the Author byline.
